rightsReview.reason: Complete carrier site-use terms, privacy policy, footer and current airport page reviewed. Copyright reserved; no raw timetable/map/photo/prose redistribution grant asserted. Airport publishes this exact public HTTP carrier link and carrier pages/assets themselves use HTTP; ordinary HTTPS attempts failed TLS without disabling verification, while published HTTP succeeds. Retain independently structured minimum static actual calls, directional restrictions and physical terminal facts only, with exact observed URL/date/hash. Current March 29-October 24 2026 timetable columns 2 independently reviewed both ways, excluding June-September seasonal column 3. Timetable explicitly omits minor stops and states all stops on the route are served with airport-bound pickup only and city-bound dropoff only. Therefore combine actual columns with separately viewed current-linked full directional maps dated December 2022, corroborated by current timetable route schematic. Preserve return-only Minato 1-chome; never infer a reversed pattern or a four-stop express. Map normalizes minor Japanese numeral orthography to exact P11 canonical names without changing the road stop; retain each exact operator/feature. Current carrier text explicitly describes airport arrival-door to boarding and alighting-to-departure-door access; no photos or measured walking distances retained.
